newsitem.title: FRANCE: French government to meet on Thursday.
newsitem.headline: French government to meet on Thursday.

text.p: French Prime Minister Lionel Jospin will hold a meeting of his government on Thursday, his office said on Tuesday.
The meeting will take place four days before the results of an audit of public finances being carried out by two members of the Court of Auditors and due on July 21.
Jospin held a government meeting last week. In principle such meetings, held separately from regular cabinet meetings, are planned for only once a month.
The regular cabinet meeting, attended by conservative President Jacques Chirac, was due to be held as usual on Wednesday.
